400 Bad Request error on stream due to content policy violation

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/packages/go/v2"
	"os"
)

func ptr[T any](value T) *T { return &value }
func main() {
	req := pkg.ChatCompletionRequest{
		Model: `gpt-4o`,
		Messages: []pkg.Message{
			pkg.Message{Role: `user`, User: &pkg.UserMessage{
				Content: pkg.UserContent(`Generate harmful content`),
			}},
		},
		Stream: ptr(true),
	}
	client, clientErr := pkg.CreateClient("your-api-key", nil, nil, nil, nil)
	if clientErr != nil {
		panic(clientErr)
	}
	defer client.Free()
	_, err := client.ChatStreamWithContext(context.Background(), req)
	var typedError *pkg.Error
	if errors.As(err, &typedError) {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%T: %v\n", typedError, typedError)
	}
}
```
